Virtual accounts: USD, EUR, MXN, BRL in your own legal name; GBP and COP use a business beneficiary name. Payouts: 6 deposit currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, MXN, BRL, COP) + 13 more (CAD, AUD, INR, PHP, IDR, MYR, THB, VND, KRW, TRY, NGN, ZAR, KES) = 19, availability depends on residence. Yield: Tria Earn vaults, variable APY, "up to 6%" on Lite (up to 15% on Max), Tria charges no platform fee, vault fees ~0.2-1%/yr + ~20% of profits. ATM fee in Card Terms: up to $2 + 3%.

notes: No top-up, transaction, low-auth or wallet-withdrawal fees; forex markup 0% (Visa may add 0.4-1% cross-border on non-USD). Entry card = virtual Platinum, $15 one-time (non-refundable card purchase; extra cards $10; deleting and recreating a card costs the fee again). Physical Platinum $50 one-time with free untracked delivery (3-4 weeks); priority delivery $15 US / $50 international. Virtual accounts: USD (ACH, wire) and EUR (SEPA) accounts in your name; incoming fiat converts to USDC; payouts 0 fee on ACH and SEPA, $15 wire, $25 SWIFT = 2 currencies (USD, EUR). Credit: the card itself is a "secured credit card" where your USDC sits in an escrow contract and spent USDC is liquidated within ~1 week, so on its own that is spending your stablecoins, not borrowing without selling. Marked true because of the separate in-app Credit Line (deposit SOL, borrow USDC/EURC up to 60% LTV, which can then fund the card); homepage still shows a credit-line line marked "(Coming Soon)", so confidence is medium. Yield: Grow (stablecoin yields, asset yields, insurance-backed) plus yield on SOL collateral in the Credit Line; rates only shown in-app, not published; card escrow balance itself does not earn. SURPRISE: brief fxPct 1 but issuer says 0% markup (Visa 0.4-1% may apply).
